summary: Energys Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that on April 21, 2026, Nasdaq notified the company it had regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(b)(2) requiring market value of listed securities of at least $35,000,000 for ten consecutive business days. The letter stated the matter is now closed. The CEO expressed satisfaction with maintaining the Nasdaq listing. This is a routine compliance update, not a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, or structural change is involved. The filing simply confirms continued listing eligibility and carries no risk-arb angle or deal terms.
